_source: DUNE's official plot style, dune_plot_style: src/matplotlib/python/dunestyle.py draws 'DUNE' bold (mathtext \bf) followed by ' Preliminary', ' Work In Progress' or ' Simulation' inside the axes at (0.05, 0.90), left-aligned, in black. https://github.com/DUNE/dune_plot_style

dune_plot_style src/matplotlib/stylelib/dune.mplstyle: Helvetica (Nimbus Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial), the Okabe-Ito cycle starting with black, image.cmap cividis, ticks in on four sides with minor ticks. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DUNE/dune_plot_style/main/src/matplotlib/stylelib/dune.mplstyle
